name: Course Overview
intro:
Module 1: Course Overview 

This module introduces the course and highlights the transformative potential of Generative AI (GenAI) in the public sector. Participants will gain an understanding of how GenAI can assist them in their work through hands-on activities and best practices. The importance of delivering value while maintaining public trust and safety is emphasized.

Click "Start Module" to begin! This module may take a few moments to load on slower connections. Thank you for your patience!

 Have questions or need assistance? Write to us at  hello@innovate-us.org

name: Explaining Generative AI: What it is
intro:
Module 2: Explaining Generative AI: What it is

In this module, participants will learn about artificial intelligence (AI) and generative AI (GenAI) in simple terms. The module explores GenAI's ability to understand, create, and synthesize knowledge based on training data. Examples demonstrate GenAI's capabilities in generating text, images, and engaging in multi-modal interaction, as well as its potential to save time and improve outcomes in government work.

Click "Start Module" to begin! This module may take a few moments to load on slower connections. Thank you for your patience!

 Have questions or need assistance? Write to us at  hello@innovate-us.org

name: Effective use part 1: How Generative AI can help your day-to-day
intro:
Module 3: Effective use part 1: How Generative AI can help your day-to-day

This module provides a systematic understanding of GenAI's application to public sector work. Participants will learn about ten key areas where GenAI can streamline tasks and be encouraged to experiment with different platforms. The module covers applications such as drafting content, brainstorming ideas, proofreading, summarizing information, role-playing, accelerating learning, coding, analyzing data, and more.

Click "Start Module" to begin! This module may take a few moments to load on slower connections. Thank you for your patience!

 Have questions or need assistance? Write to us at  hello@innovate-us.org

name: Effective use part 2: Generative AI best practices
intro:
Module 4: Effective use part 2: Generative AI best practices

Focusing on prompt engineering, this module teaches participants how to craft effective instructions for GenAI. A prompting framework with five components (Instruction, Role, Context, Format, and Example) is introduced, along with best practices for simplicity, clarity, flexibility, and efficiency. Participants will engage in hands-on exercises to refine prompts and explore techniques to enhance GenAI interactions.

Click "Start Module" to begin! This module may take a few moments to load on slower connections. Thank you for your patience!

 Have questions or need assistance? Write to us at  hello@innovate-us.org

name: Overcoming risks: Your individual use
intro:
Module 1: Overcoming risks: Your individual use

This module addresses the responsible use of GenAI by discussing potential risks and mitigation strategies. Participants will learn about data privacy, hallucinations (inaccurate outputs), and bias as key challenges. The module provides practical guidance and organizational policies to assess and avoid these risks, along with strategies to identify and mitigate them. Five crucial behaviors for responsible GenAI use are presented.

 Have questions or need assistance? Write to us at  hello@innovate-us.org

name: Societal Challenges
intro:
Module 2: Societal challenges

In this module, participants will explore the broader societal risks and uncertainties surrounding GenAI. The module focuses on copyright issues, deep fakes, astroturfing, and the private ownership of GenAI models. Participants will learn about the potential misuse of GenAI for deception, the challenges of identifying AI-generated content in public feedback, and the concentration of power among a few tech companies. The importance of aligning GenAI use with public values and the well-being of communities is emphasized.

 Have questions or need assistance? Write to us at  hello@innovate-us.org

name: Designing AI Projects in Government
intro:
Begin Course!

This course will show you how to expand and deepen AI work in your organization. We will learn about different types of AI and how it can support high-priority goals and projects. The lessons from this course will allow you to use these exciting new tools as a powerful companion to assist you in your work. By the end of this course, you will understand the different types of AI and their applications in government, and know-how to identify and prioritize high-impact AI projects. Whether you're exploring AI for the first time or looking to deepen your knowledge, this course will provide you with a solid foundation to confidently lead your organization into the age of AI.

name: Video 1 – Why Engagement Matters Today
intro:
Video 1: Why Engagement Matters Today 

This video explains how well-designed public engagement improves the legitimacy and effectiveness of decision-making for institutions, leaders, and the public. It illustrates how practitioners around the world are already using AI to analyze input, model policy options, and make participation more accessible — and sets the stage for the practical framework that follows.

Click "Start Module" to begin. The video may take a few minutes to load.

 Have questions or need assistance? Write to us at  hello@innovate-us.org

name: Video 2 – A Checklist for Planning Your Engagement
intro:
Video 2: A Checklist for Planning Your Engagement 

This video introduces the nine essential design decisions that shape whether an engagement produces meaningful, legitimate results. Learners will see how each step — from defining goals to designing a project plan — builds on the others, and how AI can enhance each one while keeping human judgment and democratic accountability at the center.

Click "Start Module" to begin. The video may take a few minutes to load.

 Have questions or need assistance? Write to us at  hello@innovate-us.org

name: Video 3 – Defining Goals for Engagement and Action
intro:
Video 3: Defining Goals for Engagement and Action 

This video explains why goal-setting is the foundation of effective public engagement. It walks through how to define goals that are specific, actionable, and transparent, and shows how AI can help refine goal statements and test messaging.

Click "Start Module" to begin. The video may take a few minutes to load.

 Have questions or need assistance? Write to us at  hello@innovate-us.org

name: Video 4 – Ensuring Ownership, Accountability and Action
intro:
Video 4: Ensuring Ownership, Accountability and Action  

This video examines who should be accountable for designing, running, and acting on engagement processes. It introduces three criteria for picking the right owner — trust, reach, and authority to act — and explains how AI can expand who is able to lead engagement.

Click "Start Module" to begin. The video may take a few minutes to load.

 Have questions or need assistance? Write to us at  hello@innovate-us.org

name: Video 5: Identifying Participants
intro:
Video 5: Identifying Participants  

This video explores the tradeoffs between self-selection and targeted selection, and between representative and non-representative approaches. It explains how different goals call for different participants and shows how AI can help identify gaps in representation.

Click "Start Module" to begin. The video may take a few minutes to load.

 Have questions or need assistance? Write to us at  hello@innovate-us.org

name: Video 6 – Designing Outreach Strategies
intro:
Video 6: Designing Outreach Strategies  

This video covers how to combine online and in-person outreach methods to reach the people your engagement is designed to involve. It explains how AI tools can translate materials, generate tailored communications, and identify who is missing from the conversation.

Click "Start Module" to begin. The video may take a few minutes to load.

 Have questions or need assistance? Write to us at  hello@innovate-us.org

name: Video 7 – Designing Incentives for Participation
intro:
Video 7: Designing Incentives for Participation  

This video distinguishes between intrinsic motivators — such as civic purpose and visible impact — and extrinsic rewards, and explains why the strongest incentive is showing people how their input will be used. It also covers how to reduce barriers through practical support and how AI can reinforce incentives by making contributions visible in real time.

Click "Start Module" to begin. The video may take a few minutes to load.

 Have questions or need assistance? Write to us at  hello@innovate-us.org

name: Video 8 – Designing the Tasks: What You Ask Participants to Do
intro:
Video 8: Designing the Tasks: What You Ask Participants to Do  

This video explains why task design determines whether participation produces usable results. It covers how to match tasks to goals, write clear and accessible instructions, and select platforms that support both participants and your team.

Click "Start Module" to begin. The video may take a few minutes to load.

 Have questions or need assistance? Write to us at  hello@innovate-us.org

name: Video 9 – Reviewing Inputs
intro:
Video 9: Reviewing Inputs 

This video walks through how to design a review process — from setting clear evaluation criteria to deciding who reviews contributions. It explains how AI can support analysis through deduplication, summarization, topic modeling, sentiment analysis, and criteria-based classification, while emphasizing that human judgment must guide final decisions

Click "Start Module" to begin. The video may take a few minutes to load.

 Have questions or need assistance? Write to us at  hello@innovate-us.org

name: Video 10 – Using What the Group Creates
intro:
Video 10: Using What the Group Creates 

This video addresses the most consequential step in engagement: turning input into action and communicating the results. It covers how to assess what you can realistically act on, how to build transparency into decisionmaking, and how AI can support real-time feedback, contribution tracing, and ongoing reporting.

Click "Start Module" to begin. The video may take a few minutes to load.

 Have questions or need assistance? Write to us at  hello@innovate-us.org

name: Video 11 – Designing Your Project Plan
intro:
Video 11: Designing Your Project Plan 

This video explains how to design a project plan by working backward from the decision you need to make. It covers how to sequence different methods across phases, assign clear ownership, and use AI to structure timelines, simulate scenarios, and stress-test your design.

Click "Start Module" to begin. The video may take a few minutes to load.

 Have questions or need assistance? Write to us at  hello@innovate-us.org

name: Video 12: Conclusion
intro:
Video 12: Conclusion 

This final video reviews the key lessons from the course and reinforces that effective engagement depends on clear goals, thoughtful design, human judgment, and a commitment to act on what communities contribute. It introduces additional resources, including an AI-powered coaching tool, to help learners design their own engagement projects.

Click "Start Module" to begin. The video may take a few minutes to load.
